title: Level streaming or World Partition cell update
fix_rationale: The trace shows the GameThread stalled during level streaming or World Partition cell activation. Adding streaming level components or initializing large actor groups in a single frame causes spikes.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms on the GameThread ({share}% of excess time) processing level streaming and actor world registration.

fixes.text: Tune World Partition streaming cell grid sizes so fewer actors are activated in a single frame.
Enable incremental actor registration / component updates during level streaming.
Reduce the density of initial actors per streaming level by using data layers.

verify: Traverse the level streaming boundary and confirm that AddToWorld and streaming update times remain smooth.
